content:
Loads of new early Prime Day deals are now live and today’s 9to5Toys Lunch Break is headlined by AirPods Max 2 dropping to a new all-time low at up to $150 off. We also have the most affordable Apple Watch Series 11 models at the best prices ever from $279, Apple Watch Ultra 3 hitting new all-time lows at $150, Apple Watch SE 3 starting down at just $199. Those deals join Apple’s latest AirTag 2 hitting the lowest price to date ahead of Prime Day from $22 each and the best deal we have ever tracked on the latest Magic Mouse. Head below for a closer look.

AirPods Max 2 just fell to the best price ever – early Prime Day all-time low now live at up to $150 off

  • AirPods Max 2 from $399 (Reg. $549) – New all-time low
  • AirPods Pro 3 $179 (Reg. $249)
  • AirPods 4 $99 (Reg. $129)

Most affordable Apple Watch Series 11 models drop to new all-time low from $279

Amazon’s official early Prime Day deal is now live on the most affordable 42mm and 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 – both models have the lowest prices ever starting today at $279 and $309 shipped, respectively. These deals join the best prices ever on AirPods Pro 3 and AirPods Max 2 at up to $150 off (the lowest price ever). Details below.

Amazon is now offering the 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 down at $279 and the 46mm model down at $309 shipped. Regularly $399 and $429 each, this is $120 off to deliver a solid 30% in savings.

  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 from $279 (Reg. $399) – New all-time low
  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 GPS + Cell from $399 (Reg. $499) – All colors
  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 from $309 (Reg. $429) – New all-time low
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 GPS + Cell from $399 (Reg. $529) – All colors

Previous to today, these two models – the most affordable two you can buy – has maxed out at $100 off. But, as of today, they have both dropped to $120 to deliver new Amazon all-time lows and the best prices we can find.

You will find deeper deals on the 46mm GPS + Cell model at $130 off as well as some new all-time lows that landed over the weekend on the more premium Titanium models as well:

  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 Natural Titanium $515 (Reg. $699)
  • 44mm Apple Watch Series 11 Slate Titanium $550 (Reg. $749)
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 Titanium $639 (Reg. $799)
  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 Slate Titanium $589 (Reg. $699)

Apple Watch Ultra 3 drops to best price ever at $150 off (Black and Natural, various band options)

Just after catching Amazon drop the most affordable Apple Watch Series 11 models down to new all-time lows from $279, it has also now dropped Apple Watch Ultra 3 to its best prices to date at $150 off the list.

Amazon is now offering several Apple Watch Ultra 3 configurations down at the new $649 shipped all-time low while the higher-end Milanese Loop options have now fallen to $749 shipped.

  • Black Apple Watch Ultra 3 w/ Black Ocean Band $649 (Reg. $799) – New all-time low
  • Black Apple Watch Ultra 3 w/ Black Alpine Loop $649 (Reg. $799) – New all-time low
  • Black Apple Watch Ultra 3 w/ Black Milanese Loop $749 (Reg. $899) – New all-time low
  • Natural Apple Watch Ultra 3 w/ Anchor Blue Ocean Band $649 (Reg. $799) – New all-time low
  • Natural Apple Watch Ultra 3 w/ Light Blue Alpine Loop $649 (Reg. $799) – New all-time low
  • Natural Apple Watch Ultra 3 w/ Blue Trail Loop $649 (Reg. $799) – New all-time low
  • Natural Apple Watch Ultra 3 w/ Natural Milanese Loop $749 (Reg. $899) – New all-time low

As you can see in the list above, these now even better price drops include both Natural and Black Titanium Ultra 3 models, all of which are sitting at the lowest prices we have ever tracked on Amazon to kick off Prime Day week.

While not every size and band combination is marked down this low right now, deals on Apple Watch Ultra 3 have been rare and never this low before, so it even be worth securing the watch itself at this price and then grab a third-party band in the meantime, but either way there are some seriously banger price drops now live on Ultra 3.

  • AirTag 2 $24 (Reg. $29) – Amazon all-time low
  • AirTag (4-pack) $89 (Reg. $99) – Amazon all-time low
